# Test fixtures

`demo/jessica.wav` was synthesized by this project with Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice (Apache-2.0) using its preset
speaker Serena, and is redistributable with the repository. `demo/jessica.txt` holds its exact transcript. Both are the
sample for the README demo and `scripts/run_all.sh`, which registers it as the voice "Jessica".
